question.worked_solution:
To evaluate this expression, we use PEMDAS.

First, consider the expression inside the parentheses:

$$
\begin{aligned}(-3)^{4}÷9\end{aligned}
$$

Applying PEMDAS to this expression, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}(-3)^{4}÷9 & = \\ 81÷9 & = \\ \frac{81}{9} & = \\ 9\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore:

$$
\begin{aligned}(-18)÷((-3)^{4}÷9) & = \\ (-18)÷9 & = \\ \frac{(-18)}{9} & = \\ -\frac{18}{9} & = \\ -2\end{aligned}
$$
